references: Repository concepts viewed as art direction; no external imagery. All generation calls from words.
fern_fronds_generated.png:
Use case: stylized-concept. Original botanical source textures for a physical material atlas. A square sheet of FOUR separated individual resurrection fern fronds, one in each of four equal vertical columns, each frond points UP and is fully visible. Genuine transparent background, no other plants, no text, no border, no ground, no cast shadows.
Each frond is a narrow pinnate blade with a gracefully bent or slightly hooked tip, a delicate central rachis and 20-28 alternate pinnae per side. The individual pinnae are round tipped oblong leathery small leaves with subtly undulating margins and delicate veins, recognizable resurrection fern that lives atop subtropical live oak limbs. Keep airy little spaces between pinnae. Blade length to overall blade width about 4.8:1, no long bare stem: a tiny petiole only at the bottom. Fronds occupy 85% of canvas height and 65% of their column width. First two medium mature fern green #4F7435 and deep #2F5031; third fresher olive green #8DA647; fourth medium green with some curled pinnae. Flat unlit diffuse albedo, NO glossy highlights, NO light gradient, NO baked shadows. Exquisite real natural botanical tissue texture, not vector, not cartoon.
reuse: Unchanged full-size moss and fern sources. Round 3 oak uses its own generated rounded blades and saved prompt.
dense_moss_generated.png: Use case: stylized-concept. Original Spanish moss botanical material cutout on truly transparent background. One tall irregular beard of real Tillandsia usneoides attached along the TOP EDGE to an offscreen limb, no visible limb. Its breadth is roughly half its hanging length: physical width 0.6m and length 1.2m. Fill most of the square canvas HEIGHT and central 55% WIDTH. Make 5 to 7 interwoven but distinct cascading tresses with substantial dense bodies near the top and upper two-thirds, splitting into narrow uneven tapered ends and curled fine wisps toward the bottom. Fine curled branching filaments and tiny very narrow leaves, tangled organically like the Spanish moss in a subtropical oak. The upper body must have dense filament bundles that stay legible at distance; 75% opaque within those tresses, but large irregular air channels between the tresses and airy lower tips. No broad leaves, no fern, no rope, no smooth ribbons, no vines, no web or fabric. A substantial hanging silvery grey-green beard, not a few scattered wires. Entire subject visible except its top attachment which touches the top edge, empty margin at sides and 3% bottom. Intrinsic colour #929C87 with a few fine #BBC0A5 ends; matte neutral diffuse unlit botanical texture painting, no directional light, no cast shadows, no highlights, no glow. Richly resolved fine organic filament curls. No text, labels or border.
